name: Escape Wall to Steal Brainrots 🧠
desc:
Welcome to Escape Wall to Steal Brainrots! 🧠

Run fast and steal Brainrots! 🏃
When the walls come, run for your life! 🧱
Stay alive and collect many Brainrots! ⚡
Boost your speed or carry limit with items from the Gear Shop! ⚙️
Upgrade your character and get more cash! 💸
Upgrade your plot to unlock more slots and place extra characters! 🏗️
Trade or gift your characters with friends and grow together! 🎁

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash! 👍
